title: Personnel of Garland's 111 Dance Hall band
summary: He names his piano, drums, saxes, trumpet, trombone and banjo-violin players, including Atwell Rose.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So what did you have for players then? Do you remember?
I had Fred Washington on the piano.
I had Everett Welch on the drums. Theodore Bonner on tenor saxophone. Robert Garner on alto saxophone. And I had Eddie -- Ed -- Eddie -- third trumpet -- third saxophone. Yeah alto saxophone.
And I had Berance Vass on trumpet. And I had Charles Vass on the trombone.
And I was on the bass.
And who was the drummer in that band?
That's right. That's right. I've got it. Okay. So you -- in this orchestra, then, you'd play from orchestrations, at 111.
Yeah. Before I forgot, I didn't call my banjo player and violin player. He doubled on violin.
